text: Good evening, so sorry to trouble you at this hour. I'm looking after my granddaughter, she's 16 months old. Her temperature is 37.8. She's had a few runny nappies today but she's drinking her milk and water well and still wetting her nappies like normal. The thing that's worrying me is she's got some little dark red spots on her legs and a couple on her arm, and I did the glass test my daughter told me about and they don't go away when I press. I'm probably fussing over nothing but I didn't want to leave it. Her mum and dad are away until tomorrow. Many thanks and apologies again.
